comments.author: henryzhangpku
comments.body:
292% annualized is an attention-grabbing number, but the missing data determines whether it is evidence or marketing: live vs. backtest, max drawdown, exposure/time in market, turnover and slippage, delistings/survivorship, benchmark, and whether the 336-day window was selected after seeing the result.



I would also want the full trade ledger and an out-of-sample period. $76,251 profit on a $30,000 adjustable balance with $5,000 positions cannot be interpreted without knowing concurrent positions, reinvestment and gross exposure.



A useful AI-agent leaderboard should rank risk-adjusted, out-of-sample performance—not raw annualized return.
